items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: access any solo, any recorded solo, Charlie Parker whatever

ctx.x: Yeah so I just want to get that on the thing because I love her and it’s incredible to meet somebody you know later on in your life that is your partner and that it’s really cool to be with somebody and you love their music, and the stuff she writes. So we have a blast playing you know her playing piano and singing her tunes and I play acoustic piano and improvise behind it, and then a rhythm section. That’s a really neat vibe. But to be able to put ideas down at home on a recorder and play them back and they…
